page.notes: Printed text as set; no reading in doubt apart from the following. "curatiohis" is printed so; probably a printing error for "curationis", left as printed. "Differentia faltem" and similar long-s words are given with plain s. Left margin shows only stains and show-through. The first marginal note is in italic type; its four printed lines are joined into one note. The last line of the page, "bonum", is cut off at the foot of the scan and may continue on the next page.
